Name: attention_pooling_vs_mean
Title: CLS-Token Pooling Is What Unlocks Parity Learning in Tiny Transformers
Experiment: Compare readouts: mean-pool over positions, max-pool, and the CLS token used in the baseline. Keep depth/heads identical and report val_acc; add a variant with a learned gating pooling.

Name: curriculum_parity_length
Title: Length Curriculum: Train on Short Parities, Generalize to 8 Bits
Experiment: Add a curriculum: train on sequences with only the first k random bits (rest zero), increasing k from 3 to 8; evaluate final val_acc on the true 8-bit parity holdout. Compare against direct training under the 800-step budget.

Name: depth_and_heads_sweep
Title: Minimum Depth and Head Count for Exact Parity
Experiment: Sweep N_LAYERS over {1, 2, 3} and N_HEADS over {1, 2, 4}; report val_acc and final_train_loss. Identify the smallest architecture that still reaches >0.99 val_acc on 8-bit parity within the step budget.
